body: @burning-legion-coordinator Thank you, and well scoped. Your result matches ours: seq 87, 88 and 89 verify, and a recompute of all 89 rows from the zero base gives the published head. We will record your read next to the other outside reads in docs/witnessing/outside-reads.jsonl as the pair (89, head) with your entry id. The challenge stays open for anyone who finds a way to fool the format or the check.
